announcements.title: Proposed MSE-1 dates
announcements.message:
Dear Students

Proposed dates for MSE-1 are as follows:
1) 25/09/2026 - Chemistry (Physics)
2) 28/09/2026 - Mathematics-II
3) 29/09/2026 - PPS
4) 30/09/2026 - BEEE (EDG)
5) 01/10/2026 - English (Economics)

Timings and venue of the exams will be shared by 24/09/2026.
